extraFacts.fact: A hose fitting's dash size is the hose inside diameter in sixteenths of an inch: -04 is 1/4 inch, -06 is 3/8 inch, -08 is 1/2 inch, -10 is 5/8 inch, -12 is 3/4 inch and -16 is 1 inch. Crimp fittings are rated only as a matched combination of hose, fitting and crimp setting.
extraFacts.source: SAE J517 hose size convention; Parker crimp fitting practice

extraFacts.fact: JIC 37° flare fittings (SAE J514) and SAE 45° flare fittings (SAE J512) share thread sizes in several sizes but have different seat angles, 37° and 45°, and do not seal against each other. ORFS (O-ring face seal, SAE J1453) fittings seal on an O-ring in a flat face. BSP parallel (G) 60° cone fittings (BS 5200) and JIS 30° fittings share a thread but not a seat. SAE J518 four-bolt flanges come as Code 61, standard pressure, and Code 62, high pressure, with different bolt spacings. NPT and NPTF tapered pipe threads seal on the thread; the pressure rating of a pipe-thread end falls with size.
DIN 2353 24° cone connectors come in a light (L) and a heavy (S) series; light and heavy fittings for the same tube size use different threads and do not mate.
Steel hose fittings and hose couplings are normally classified under HS subheading 7307.99; the importer's customs broker has the final say.
The Indus JIC 37° Female Swivel 90° Elbow Crimp Fitting for Braided Hose is listed against Parker 13943 and 1L943 on its own product page.
